summary: CoSpine首人完整230帧已映射到MNI；15个固定早期窗口和6个时间参考敏感性窗口完成21次冻结NeuroSTORM内部前向。真实时空特征全部为有限值，独立读回通过。
boundary: 这是1名健康热痛受试者的输入与表示实验，预测拟合0、专家新增0。池化向量在15窗口间变化很小，不能当作疼痛稳定性或有效性。事件插值/空间补边/整段归一化采用明确的本地设置；原切片参考与时间滤波仍未知，不能证明评分信号已排除。
next: 先用固定的重复帧与时间顺序对照检查时空表示，区分位置编码、静态成分与真实动态；再在原26开发/13研究留出范围内开展有限疼痛任务适配，与冻结表示、作者提示调优、同容量监督及适用FC/协变量公平比较。旧停止分支保持，三个独立临床目标尚未完成。

tokens.normalization: Full mapped native scan foreground pooled mean and sample std; negative values clamped after nonzero background definition; background set to minimum foreground z; single native-scan symmetric int8 scale. Offline local protocol, not author post-whole-run-resampling moments.
tokens.interpretation: Real healthy first-person early-response tokens only, no pain-head training, independent-person gain, clinical patient evidence or novelty. Spatial padding is background, no temporal padding; local event-time interpolation/native-scan moments differ from author whole-run preprocessing. Full-scan moments and unknown derivative filtering may mix later information. Tokens are 2x2x2 spatial cells, not AAL90.

independent_review.interpretation: Independent raw header/value checks and event interpolation/quantization/cache arithmetic only. Similar pooled vectors can reflect shared/static components and are not pain stability. No encoder rerun, pain prediction or expert/clinical proof.

existing_warnings_retained: Apptainer fuse2fs missing warning retained; actual SIF applywarp exited zero, no EXT3 filesystem requested.
author_pipeline_differences: Author center crop leaves short axes short; local 91x96x91 is padded with declared background to 96^3 without removing reference-brain voxels or filling missing time frames.
Author whole-run temporal interpolation uses align_corners=False and rounded run length; local windows interpolate actual event target times directly using declared frame references.

Local per-scan moments and int8 scale are computed on mapped native frames before event interpolation; author computes them after whole-run temporal interpolation. Both use whole-scan information, local method is offline only.
